independence.statement: This audit was derived in session 8c38294d1379, independently of translator session 3874e9cb17a0. The auditor did not author or edit the contribution, used no translation API/SDK/MT service, and left the source worktree untouched.

findings.current: 暂无对话。请选择智能体、团队或“新建对话”。
findings.proposed: 暂无对话。选择智能体、团队或“新建对话”。
findings.reason: The zh-CN style guide permits “请” only when the English says “please” in a blocking dialog; this ordinary empty-state instruction does not meet that condition.
“分叉” is a Git-style calque for fork; “创建对话分支” is the idiomatic Simplified Chinese action for branching a conversation.
“重新刷新” is redundant in native UI Chinese, while “重试刷新” is terser and preserves the deliberate distinction from the connection-level Retry action.
“连接对话” reads as connecting conversations to one another; naming the backend-provided conversation service makes the intended wait idiomatic and unambiguous.

findings.current: 会话已不再持有此回答提到的凭据。
findings.proposed: 此会话中已没有此回答提到的凭据。
findings.reason: “持有凭据” is legalistic English-style wording; the proposed security notice is natural Chinese and does not imply deletion, persistence, or disclosure beyond the source.

findings.current: 此对话已不存在于此电脑上。
findings.proposed: 此电脑上已没有此对话。
findings.reason: “不存在于” is a literal English construction; “已没有” states the same local absence in native product Chinese.
The filter describes hierarchy rather than quality or rank, so “顶层” is the native technical term and avoids reading “顶级” as “top-rated”.

evidence.icu_and_placeholders: An independent probe using @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and IntlMessageFormat parsed and formatted all 13 ICU-bearing scoped messages at representative counts 0, 1, 2, and 1234. Argument names/types, select arms, and number skeletons match; the only structural locale adaptation is collapsing English plural one/other to zh-CN other. No unresolved, dropped, or renamed placeholders; failures=[].

cldr_plural_evidence.conclusion: The target uses only the actual zh-CN CLDR category, renders the count in the sentence, and preserves ::group-off rather than introducing grouped digits.

evidence.pseudo_localization: A source-only AST pseudo-localization probe transformed literal text in all 134 English messages and both locale forms, preserved the complete ICU structure, reparsed every result, and formatted every result with IntlMessageFormat. 134/134 source messages changed and all pseudo forms parsed/formatted; this is mechanical placeholder/pseudo evidence, not rendered geometry evidence.
evidence.typography_and_rtl: All 134 targets are NFC; zero manual bidi or zero-width controls, zero ASCII '...' or single-dot ellipses, and zero byte-identical English values. Full-width prose punctuation and double …… ellipses follow the guide. The only ASCII colons are ui.chat.canonical.supplement.details.attempts/model, retained deliberately because their diagnostic sidecars require the source separator. zh-CN is LTR, so RTL layout is not applicable.

allowed_english_tokens.untranslated_prose: None found. The complete Latin-run inventory consists only of the explicitly allowed product/technical tokens above and ICU syntax; no scoped value is an English stub.

evidence.security_sensitive_semantics: Read the actual warning and confirmation copy: provider cancellation remains best-effort, generation continues, audio may still be charged, neither cancellation nor absence of charge is guaranteed; forget/logout copy removes only the named stored credential; stop confirmation preserves session count and immediate stop semantics. No security meaning was weakened.
evidence.static_overflow: Measured rendered sample text with CJK/full-width=2 cells and ASCII=1. Nine of 134 targets are longer than English: Jobs 4->8 cells (+4), Open folder 11->14 (+3), Opening 8->10 (+2), and six labels +1. No materially long label or new static overflow finding; all other 125 targets are equal or shorter. Dynamic names and real wrapping remain for the later rendered gate.
evidence.limitations: Catalogue/source audit only. No browser, real-app frame, screen-reader, activation, release, or rendered-fit evidence is claimed; the programme's later real-app frame gate remains required. Product-name consistency finding T-008 includes pre-existing peer entries solely as comparison evidence; the scoped Canvas/Finder values themselves follow their sidecars.
